items.title: Atletico agree deal to sign Spurs captain Romero
items.description: Atletico Madrid have agreed a deal in principle with Tottenham to sign Cristian Romero.

items.title: Guimaraes makes bow and Lewis-Skelly scores as Arsenal held by Como
items.description: Bruno Guimaraes made his first appearance and Myles Lewis-Skelly scored amid speculation about his future as Arsenal were held to a 1-1 draw by Como in their final pre-season friendly.

items.title: Jaissle 'aware' of Newcastle needs after Everton friendly loss

items.title: Chelsea stars for sale: The players who could leave - and what they'll cost

items.title: Xavi becomes first non-Dutch Netherlands coach since 1978

items.title: Sports fans watch on as Britain experiences fullest solar eclipse since 1999
items.description: Cricket fans at Edgbaston were among sporting spectators given a stunning view of Wednesday evening's partial solar eclipse.

items.title: Chawinga sisters fire Malawi into Wafcon final
